$comment: Confetti LIGHT — no neutrals of its own (the base light mode IS Confetti's), only the premium motion and type: nothing moves on hover (the lift shadows do the work), cards stay square instead of tilting, and headings drop to regular (400) weight. Mirrors the same entries in confetti.dark.json. Emitted under [data-theme='confetti'][data-mode='light'].

lift.comment: hover changes light, not position — and sets no transform at all, so nothing is re-rasterized
